title: multiplexd configuration
description: Configuration file for multiplexd. At least one of 'mux_listen', 'mux_connect', or 'identity.mux_connect' must be present.

type.description: MIME media type string; must parse as application/x-multiplexd-config with parameter version=1 (validated by conf_check_type in conf.c, not by this schema).

api_listen.description: HTTP management API listen address, e.g. '127.0.0.1:9081'.

mux_listen.description: Address to listen for inbound mux connections (server mode).

mux_connect.description: Address to dial for the outbound mux connection (client mode).

listen.description: Local address to accept application connections.

connect.description: Target address to forward application connections to.

log.description: Log destination. stdout and stderr write to the respective standard streams; terminal writes to stderr with ANSI colors; syslog sends to the system logger; discard suppresses all output.

max_startups.description: Rate-limit unauthenticated connections. Format: 'start:rate%:full'. Up to 'start' connections are accepted freely; beyond that each new one is rejected with probability 'rate'% until 'full' is reached.

tls.description: TLS credentials. cert, key, and authcerts must all be set or all absent (plaintext mode).

cert.description: PEM certificate. Use '@/path/to/cert.pem' to load from a file.

key.description: PEM private key. Use '@/path/to/key.pem' to load from a file.

ciphersuites.description: Colon-separated list of TLS 1.3 ciphersuites to allow, by IANA name: TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256, TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384, TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256, TLS_AES_128_CCM_SHA256, TLS_AES_128_CCM_8_SHA256. These names work with both the OpenSSL and the mbedTLS build; an mbedTLS build also accepts mbedTLS's own spellings (e.g. TLS1-3-AES-128-GCM-SHA256), which OpenSSL does not recognize. With tls.psk only the SHA-256 suites of the list are used, in their listed order: a PSK is always bound to SHA-256 on both builds, and a list with no SHA-256 suite is refused.

sni.description: Server Name Indication sent in the client TLS handshake. Set to an empty string to omit the SNI extension entirely. Not sent with tls.psk, which has no certificate for the name to select.

alpn.description: Comma-separated ALPN protocol list advertised (client) or selected (server) in the TLS handshake. Empty (the default) omits the ALPN extension entirely.

psk.description: External pre-shared keys, keyed by peer identity. Values are lowercase hex (at least 32 octets) or '@path' to a file holding the same. Mutually exclusive with cert/key/authcerts: a PSK handshake sends no certificate in either direction. Generate with --genpsk; a hand-written key is unsafe, because the identity label published on the wire is derived from it. When dialing, the first entry is the one offered.

additionalProperties.description: Lowercase hex key, or '@path'. A map value, so it bypasses generated per-field checks; conf.c enforces length and format instead, on an inline key when the config is parsed and on an '@path' key once the file is loaded.

authcerts.description: Allowed peer certificates. Each entry is '@/path/to/cert.pem' or an inline PEM string.

socket_offload.description: Enable the TLS library to own the socket and perform record I/O directly. When disabled (the default) the mux drives the library over in-memory buffers and batches records into larger socket writes, which is faster on loopback and low-latency links; enable it to let the library (or the kernel, via 'kernel_offload') own the socket fd.

kernel_offload.description: Enable kernel TLS (KTLS) offload so the kernel frames and encrypts records and can coalesce them into full segments. Defaults to true, taking effect only once 'socket_offload' is also enabled; ignored (and forced back off) when unsupported or when 'socket_offload' is disabled.

nodelay.description: Send mux frames immediately without coalescing.

tcp.description: TCP socket options for the mux connection.

reuseport.description: Allow multiple processes to bind the same mux port.

keepalive.description: Enable TCP-level keepalive on the mux socket.

nodelay.description: Disable Nagle algorithm on the mux socket.

sndbuf.description: Send buffer size hint in bytes. 0 = OS default.

rcvbuf.description: Receive buffer size hint in bytes. 0 = OS default.

notsent_lowat.description: Unsent-data low-water mark in bytes. 0 = OS default.

backlog.description: TCP listen backlog for the mux socket.

max_halfopen.description: Maximum half-open streams per session. 0 = no limit.

max_streams.description: Maximum concurrent streams per session. 0 = unlimited.

connect_timeout.description: Time limit in seconds for each TCP connect and handshake attempt. Positive values below 10 are raised to 10. 0 = disabled (wait indefinitely).

keepalive.description: Interval in seconds between keepalive PING frames, each answered by the peer (encrypted TCP-keepalive over the tunnel). The session is declared dead after keepalive + max(keepalive / 10, 90) seconds with no inbound traffic: 1.1x only from 900 up, e.g. 390 at 300, 7920 at the default 7200, and 100 at the floor of 10. Positive values below 10 are raised to 10. 0 = disabled.

send_timeout.description: Seconds without send progress before the session is suspended and reconnected, enabling faster detection of stalled connections. Positive values below 10 are raised to 10. 0 = disabled.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity with no open streams before a session is closed. Positive values below 10 are raised to 10. 0 = disabled.

resume_timeout.description: Seconds a suspended session is held on the server waiting for the client to reconnect. Positive values below 10 are raised to 10. 0 = disabled (held indefinitely).

session_window.description: Session-level send concurrency cap in bytes. Rounded down to a multiple of 16384 (16 KiB), with a floor of 65536: any smaller nonzero value becomes 65536. 0 = automatic.

stream_window.description: Per-stream receive buffer size in bytes advertised to the peer. Rounded down to a multiple of 16384 (16 KiB), with a floor of 65536: any smaller nonzero value becomes 65536. 0 = automatic.

readahead.description: Receive read-ahead window in bytes: contiguous buffer space offered to one transport read so a single recv() can drain several frames, amortizing the syscall and event-loop cost. Larger values raise throughput on loopback and low-latency links at the cost of receive buffer memory. With 'tls.socket_offload' enabled only the on/off state matters (it drives the library read-ahead). 0 disables read-ahead. The wire frame size is unchanged.

max_frame_size.description: Maximum total bytes per outbound mux frame (8-byte header + payload). Larger frames raise single-stream throughput; omit to use the default.

mem_pressure.description: Per-session receive-buffer pressure thresholds for scaling new window grants. These thresholds do not cap receive-buffer memory. hi = 0 disables.

hi.description: High watermark in buffered receive bytes; new window grants scale down linearly toward 1/8 between lo and hi and stay at that minimum above hi. At least one window unit is granted whenever that much credit is grantable. 0 = disabled.

lo.description: Low watermark in buffered receive bytes; new window grants remain unscaled at or below this threshold. 0 = hi / 2.

lossymux.description: Best-effort UDP relay over the mux session (the bilateral 'lossymux' hello extension). Active on a session only when both peers enable it.

enabled.description: Advertise the lossymux extension and bind a UDP socket on every 'listen' and 'identity.listen' address; inbound flows are relayed to the 'connect' target over UDP.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds without a datagram in either direction before a UDP flow is dropped.

queue.description: Maximum datagrams queued per session awaiting transmission; a datagram arriving while the queue is full is dropped.

tcp.description: TCP socket options for local (application-side) connections.

reuseport.description: Allow multiple processes to bind the same local listen port.

keepalive.description: Enable TCP-level keepalive on local sockets.

nodelay.description: Disable Nagle algorithm on local sockets.

sndbuf.description: Send buffer size hint in bytes. 0 = OS default.

rcvbuf.description: Receive buffer size hint in bytes. 0 = OS default.

notsent_lowat.description: Unsent-data low-water mark in bytes. 0 = OS default.

backlog.description: TCP listen backlog for the local listener.

claim.description: This node's identity string, presented to peers during handshake. Required when routing by identity.

verify.description: Require a peer's claimed identity to appear as a URI subjectAltName ('multiplexd:<identity>', percent-encoded) in the certificate it presented. A peer that claims no identity is unaffected and stays unidentified. Requires TLS; applies to newly accepted sessions and to future handshakes on existing ones.

mux_connect.description: Mux endpoints to dial; one persistent outbound session is maintained per entry.

listen.description: Per-peer local listen addresses. Keys are peer identity strings; values are local TCP addresses.

additionalProperties.description: Local TCP address to accept traffic for this peer. A map value, so it bypasses generated per-field checks; maxLength is enforced by conf_check in conf.c instead.
